scope_note: Civilian software repositories, product surfaces, practitioner communities, recorded-media access points, and a primary cognitive-state study used to audit claims in the motivating conversation.

sources.title: psitool: Tools for aiding remote viewing
sources.authors_or_owner: psitool GitHub organization and repository contributors
sources.stance_or_result: The GPL-3.0 Rust repository documents utilities for selecting from local target pools, avoiding completed targets, downloading Wikimedia candidates, preserving target metadata, generating content-derived identifiers, revealing targets, and recording user-entered practice notes.
sources.limitations: Repository functionality does not validate remote viewing. The documented workflow does not by itself supply independent assignment custody, immutable transcript locking, blind decoy judging, preregistration, or objective scoring; deployment and current maintenance must be checked separately.
sources.rights_note: Code is identified by the repository as GPL-3.0. Link to the upstream repository and preserve its license, notices, and target-media rights.

sources.title: RVMe
sources.authors_or_owner: nykotar and contributors; described as maintained by moderators of r/remoteviewing
sources.stance_or_result: The AGPL-3.0 repository documents a collaborative target-pool website with moderated targets, difficulty levels, additional feedback, no-repeat selection, personal targets, and a target-at-reveal precognitive mode.
sources.limitations: The repository is archived. Its README documents intended features, not the security, availability, or exact behavior of any current deployment, and none of the features establishes anomalous perception.
sources.rights_note: Code is identified by the repository as AGPL-3.0. Link to the archived upstream repository and observe target-media rights separately.

sources.title: ECHO-CLAW
sources.authors_or_owner: lukeskytorep-bot repository; named human and AI collaborators in the README
sources.stance_or_result: The CC BY 4.0 repository proposes target-separated AI Monitor and Viewer roles, external memory, post-reveal correction, and future multi-agent remote-viewing experiments, while explicitly disclaiming proof, completion, and guaranteed success.
sources.limitations: The repository is primarily architecture, documents, examples, and templates. Role names do not prove process isolation, target blindness, valid scoring, or efficacy.
sources.rights_note: Repository materials are identified as CC BY 4.0; linked PDFs and third-party material may have distinct rights and require separate review.

sources.title: ClairV web application surface
sources.authors_or_owner: ClairV web application publisher; ownership not independently resolved in this review
sources.stance_or_result: A JavaScript application surface was reachable at the reviewed domain.
sources.limitations: The rendered surface did not expose enough information here to verify target generation, scoring, privacy, deployment revision, or source-code provenance. No claim of open-source status is made by this module.
sources.rights_note: External web application. Link only; do not copy code, targets, branding, or user content.

sources.title: VEREVIO - ESP & Remote Viewing
sources.authors_or_owner: Kostart Ltd; Apple App Store listing
sources.stance_or_result: The listing describes remote-viewing, telepathy, precognition, postcognition, whiteboard, quiz, target, scan-box, and statistics features, with in-app purchases and privacy disclosures.
sources.limitations: Vendor descriptions, ratings, and promotional language are not independent validation. The listing does not provide an auditable target corpus, randomization log, scoring implementation, complete trial ledger, or efficacy study.
sources.rights_note: Proprietary application and listing content. Link only; do not reproduce app assets or user data.

sources.title: Social RV practice platform
sources.stance_or_result: The platform says it assigns random targets, accepts session uploads, reveals after submission, and uses a blind AI judge to rank the target against nine decoys.
sources.limitations: The public product surface does not independently establish the deployed code, target-label isolation, model and prompt stability, decoy fairness, data completeness, statistical calibration, or efficacy.
sources.rights_note: External proprietary service. Link only; do not republish targets, screenshots, scoring prompts, or user sessions without permission.

sources.title: International Remote Viewing Association
sources.stance_or_result: IRVA describes itself as a nonprofit membership organization for remote-viewing education, research, history, conferences, practice, and professional networking.
sources.limitations: An organizational self-description establishes activities and access points, not the efficacy of remote viewing or independent validation of member claims.
sources.rights_note: External organization site. Link and quote sparingly; conference, archive, magazine, and member materials may have separate access and rights terms.

sources.title: IRVA Focal Point
sources.stance_or_result: The programme publishes practice targets and later feedback, accepts completed sessions, and asks target contributors to use public-domain or Creative Commons images.
sources.limitations: A practice programme is not automatically a preregistered experiment; participant selection, missing sessions, judging, and complete outcome accounting require separate records.
sources.rights_note: External programme. Link only and respect target-image licenses, participant privacy, and membership terms.

sources.title: Remote Viewing Fireside Chats
sources.stance_or_result: IRVA provides an index of recorded conversations and talks with remote-viewing practitioners and researchers.
sources.limitations: Interviews and talks document testimony and viewpoints. Unless a specific recording includes auditable blind tasking, complete artifacts, and independent judging, it is not a controlled efficacy test.
sources.rights_note: External recorded media. Link to the publisher; do not mirror video or transcripts without permission.

sources.title: Remote Viewing I programme
sources.stance_or_result: The programme describes Viewer, Monitor, and Judge roles, double-blind independently judged trials, audio exercises, live training, and use of recorded presentations when necessary.
sources.limitations: Provider descriptions, course exercises, biographies, testimonials, and demonstrations are not independent evidence of efficacy. Trial artifacts and analysis would need separate release.
sources.rights_note: External commercial programme. Link only; course materials, audio, recordings, and participant data are proprietary or private.

sources.title: r/remoteviewing community
sources.stance_or_result: The community hosts guides, discussions, software and target-pool leads, and user-posted remote-viewing material.
sources.limitations: Posts are user-generated, self-selected, editable, and potentially incomplete. Community popularity and striking session posts do not establish controlled performance.
sources.rights_note: Link to posts and preserve attribution. Do not bulk-copy user content or treat public posting as consent for research redistribution.

sources.title: Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) impairs visual working memory performance: a randomized crossover trial
sources.authors_or_owner: Kirsten C. S. Adam, Manoj K. Doss, Elisa Pabon, Edward K. Vogel, and Harriet de Wit
sources.stance_or_result: Two double-blind randomized crossover experiments reported that acute oral THC impaired visual working-memory performance, increased mind wandering in one experiment, and reduced metacognitive accuracy in another.
sources.limitations: This was not a remote-viewing study and cannot determine whether THC improves or worsens remote-viewing outcomes. Samples were modest and tested specified acute oral doses and cognitive tasks.
sources.rights_note: Link to the PubMed record and article identifiers; do not republish publisher-owned text or figures beyond applicable terms.
